##### Project general facts

Reem by Vision is a spectacular residential development that brings together spacious design, elegance, and modern comfort. This project offers a wide range of units including studios and one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, catering to a diverse set of lifestyles. Each apartment is generously sized, with high ceilings and expansive floor-to-floor windows that invite natural light and open up to breathtaking panoramic views, creating a living space that is both inspiring and welcoming.

What truly sets Reem by Vision apart is its exceptional collection of amenities designed to enhance every aspect of residents' daily lives. From an infinity pool and state-of-the-art gym to a private cinema, gaming room, and yoga area, every feature is created with comfort and enjoyment in mind. Residents can also benefit from thoughtful extras like a party hall, kids' play areas, BBQ space, and concierge services, ensuring every moment at home is elevated.

Reem by Vision's interiors reflect a strong commitment to quality, with modern finishing using high-quality materials and a smart home system. Kitchens are fully equipped with Bosch appliances, and every detail has been carefully considered to ensure excellence. The design philosophy transforms each residence into more than just a home — it's a lifestyle crafted for comfort, elegance, and peace of mind. 

##### Location description and benefits 

Nestled in Liwan, a dynamic and well-integrated residential community in the heart of Dubai, this exceptional location offers a harmonious blend of modern living, convenience, and tranquility. The community is characterized by its thoughtfully planned infrastructure, spacious landscaped parks, and pedestrian-friendly pathways, promoting a sense of connectivity and community engagement.

The location is distinguished by its central positioning, ensuring easy access to major road networks, making commuting and exploring the city effortless. The presence of schools, mosques, retail centers, and recreational spaces within the community emphasizes its self-sustained nature, offering residents everything they need right at their doorstep. With a mix of residential options including apartments and townhouses, Liwan caters to various family sizes and lifestyles.

For those seeking a residence that embodies modern elegance, community connection, and a prime Dubai address, Liwan delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of thoughtful infrastructure, green spaces, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living.
